prompt: 我希望我现在就在那列火车上，但事实上不在。哪一句正确？

choices.text: I wish I am on that train
I wish I were on that train
I wish I were on that train and I really am
I wish I had been on that train now as a present fact

explanation: 与现在相反，wish 后面用 were。
verify: "I wish I were on that train"

prompt: 她希望当时没有误车。哪一句正确？

choices.text: She wishes she did not missed the train
She wishes she has not missed the train
She wishes she had not missed the train
She wishes she missed not the train

explanation: 与过去相反用 had not missed。
verify: "She wishes she had not missed the train"

prompt: I wish the delay ___ shorter. 说的是现在这场延误，横线处填哪一个？
explanation: 希望现在的情况不同，用 were。

prompt: 哪一句表示后悔已经发生的事？

choices.text: I wish I had taken more photos
I wish I took more photos now
I wish I take more photos
I wish I have more photos

explanation: had taken 表示当时没多拍，现在后悔。

prompt: 要是现在能看见那片一望无际的平原就好了。哪一句正确？

choices.text: If only I can see the boundless plain
If only I could saw the plain
If only I could see the boundless plain
If only can I see the plain

explanation: If only 表示现在不能实现的愿望，用 could see。

prompt: 要是当时带了外套就好了。哪一句正确？

If only I have brought a coat

explanation: 与过去相反用 had brought。

prompt: If only the train ___ on time now. 横线处填哪一个？

prompt: 哪一句是对过去的遗憾？

prompt: Really? 用明显的升调，更可能表示什么？

prompt: Well... I am not sure. 把 Well 拖长并略升，更可能表示什么？

prompt: I DID see the frost. 重读 DID，更可能表示什么？
explanation: 重读 did 是在强调谓语，表示确实如此。

prompt: 哪一种读法更礼貌地表示没有听清？

choices.text: Sorry 用很重的降调并突然停止

explanation: 升调的 Sorry 常用来请对方再说一遍，比降调生硬的说法更礼貌。
